Title: Verify successful login with valid credentials redirects to Dashboard
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The login page is reachable and the environment is qa.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: Login page loads showing the OrangeHRM logo, Username field, Password field, Login button, and 'Forgot your password?' link | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the field labelled 'Username' → Expected: Username field displays 'Admin' with no validation error | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the field labelled 'Password' → Expected: Password field shows masked characters with no validation error | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: User is authenticated and redirected to the Dashboard page within 3 seconds; the URL contains '/dashboard' and the dashboard header is visible
Expected Result: User is authenticated, redirected to the Dashboard, and a valid authenticated session is established.

Title: Verify login fails with valid username and invalid password showing generic error
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin'. The login page is reachable.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: Login page is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: Username field displays 'Admin' | 3. Enter 'WrongPass999' into the Password field → Expected: Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed; the message does not indicate whether username or password was wrong; the user remains on the Login page
Expected Result: Authentication fails, a generic 'Invalid credentials' error appears, and the user stays on the Login page.

Title: Verify pressing Enter with valid credentials triggers login
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login page is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: Username field displays 'Admin' | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: Password field shows masked characters | 4. Press the Enter key while focus is in the Password field → Expected: The login process is triggered and the user is redirected to the Dashboard
Expected Result: Enter-key submission authenticates the user and redirects to the Dashboard.
